title: Yara and the Machine
author: Sable Lockridge
blurb: Silas Eriksen, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
